title: Terminal Machine architecture
summary: Terminal Machine is terminal-neutral automation infrastructure. Transport, protocol, presentation model, semantic known-state memory, control authority, service hosting and emulator recovery are separable layers; TN5250 is one personality rather than the generic core.
invariants: Generic Terminal Machine code must not acquire TN5250-specific assumptions merely for convenience.
Detached snapshots/actions/evidence remain value objects unless lifecycle identity is actually required.
procedure: Trace a live 5250 path as TCP/TLS -> Telnet -> TN5250/RFC1205 framing -> 5250 workstation data stream -> field model -> known-state/automation.
Keep future personalities such as TN3270E, VT/TTY, serial/PTY and replay behind the same generic boundaries.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
